messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGE: PagerDuty alert triggered -> PD-INC-8421. Multiple alerts for gpu-az2-node-47 and gpu-az2-node-48. Symptoms: kernel panic (trace) then kubelet NotReady. Auto-evac attempted but failed. Details: https://pd.example/INC-8421
devon: acked. i'm on it. grabbing serial + kubeview. any customer-facing spikes?
maria: @devon seeing increased 5xx on /v1/generate from inference-prod-us-east2. dashboards show 8% error rate on the beige-ranker cluster. tagging customer-impact.
samir: PD shows a burst of similar alerts in a 30s window. looks like PagerDuty sent duplicate symptoms from the same host and then retried, causing multiple pages. filing that separately but will focus on mitigation first.
jia: from k8s: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep "NotReady|gpu-az2-node-4[7-8]"`
```
# nodes
gpu-az2-node-47   Ready,SchedulingDisabled   <none>   10.12.47.9   4d
gpu-az2-node-48   NotReady                   <none>   10.12.48.11  1h
inference-prod-01 Ready                      <none>   10.12.10.2   2d
```
devon: node-47 was cordoned by autopager but drain failed (container runtime unresponsive). node-48 shows kubelet heartbeat loss. i'm attaching serial console tail:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: Xid 79: GPU hung
[ 1234.568012] kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```
maria: which workloads are on those hosts? need to ID top inference replicas.
jia: `kubectl get pods -o wide -n inference | egrep "gpu-az2-node-4[7-8]"`
```
inference-gen-5   1/1 Running   gpu-az2-node-47
ranker-12         0/1 CrashLoop gpu-az2-node-48
```
samir: looks like ranker was already crashing on node-48. combined with kernel oops on 47 -> cascading customer errors. recommendation: drain 47 for now, force-delete pods where runtime hung, failover ranker to spare pool.
devon: starting with safe steps: 1) hold further autopager evacs for this rack (rate limit) 2) cordon + try `kubectl drain gpu-az2-node-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` 3) if drain blocks, hard-reboot via BMC.
maria: also notify SRE-messaging to throttle reroutes to fallback model to avoid sudden spike on spare pool. i'll send status to #customer-impact.
jia: running drain now, output: 
```
Warning: ignoring DaemonSet-managed pods: fluentd
evicting inference-gen-5... pod stuck in Terminating (container runtime hang)
error: unable to drain, remove pod inference-gen-5 by force?
```
devon: container runtime still hung. issuing BMC reboot on node-47 (IPMI: 10.1.47.2). paging infra-ops.
pagerduty-bot: Notice: PD suppression triggered: 2 duplicate alerts suppressed in 00:00:25. Backoff policy: burst=5, window=60s.
samir: that suppression is what caused alerts to appear as a burst to oncall earlier — PD retried then suppressed which made the incidentbot send multiple pages before suppression took effect. we need to avoid duplicate autopages while node is flapping. runbook update item.
devon: BMC reboot sent. giving node 90s then re-check kubelet + serial. moving traffic off live replicas: scaling inference-gen -> replicas=0 in that node pool, routing to inference-spare-pool.
maria: customer-impact note: we saw sustained 5xx for 6 mins peaking at 12% for a small subset of customers on us-east2. ops message posted to #customer-impact with mitigation steps.
jia: node-47 serial after reboot shows kernel loaded but nvme errors: 
```
nvme0: I/O 4294967295 timeout, aborting
kernel: nvme 0000:65:00.0: enabling HDA workaround
```
samir: NVMe + GPU hang suggests hardware starting to fail. propose removing both nodes from pool (47 & 48) and RMA 47. mark 48 for deeper kubelet journald check and reimage.
devon: agreed. i'm opening an infra ticket to isolate both, schedule reimage for 48, RMA for 47. quick checklist: update PD escalation policy to increase dedupe window for this alert type, add incidentbot suppression check for hardware Xid79, and add a guard in autoscaler to avoid scaling into recently-failed-rack.
maria: will follow up with product to surface degraded region status to customers if we see any lingering errors.
jia: final checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference | egrep "CrashLoop|Error|Terminating"` -> only a few transient restarts, overall traffic routed successfully to spare pool.
devon: handing off to morning oncall @samir for followups and RMA coordination. leaving notes in #oncall-books. closing page for now — will re-open if node comes back flapping. :thumbsup:
samir: ack handoff, i'll pick up RMA + runbook edits. filing PD suppression tweak ticket: TKT-2337. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
